name: Park Ji-woo
bio:
Ji-woo's fascination with motorsport began during her university days, captivated by the intricate electronics powering Formula SAE projects. After graduating with a degree in electrical engineering from KAIST, she initially worked on developing control systems for electric vehicles. However, the lure of motorsport proved too strong, leading her to pursue opportunities in racing. 

Her approach to electronics engineering is deeply rooted in meticulous analysis and innovative problem-solving. She believes in understanding the underlying principles of every component and system, allowing her to identify potential weaknesses and propose creative solutions. While still developing her practical experience on the track, Ji-woo's visionary approach and natural creativity make her a promising addition to any race team, determined to push the boundaries of electronics technology in motorsport.

 Currently, she is focused on improving her practical skills and gaining real-world experience, eager to apply her theoretical knowledge to enhance vehicle performance and reliability on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy with subtle highlights
physical.description: Park Ji-woo has a warm smile and a focused gaze, suggesting both her intelligence and her approachable nature.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with circuit diagrams and innovative ideas.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deeply focused on a problem.
Insists on having a cup of green tea before starting any major project.
